dreamteamer.title: Git identities
dreamteamer.description: Optional folder-scoped Git identity planning and verification. The managing-git-identities skill separates commit authorship, remote authentication and AI subscriptions. The CLI prints proposed configuration or checks a local repository, never changing Git, SSH, keys or credentials.
